summary: Maeve Ellery, verified and writing through the secure portal, asked to move the next run of her standing order to Willow Yard Studios from 18 September to 22 September 2025, and she confirmed the change. The record doesn't show the date actually being changed or the processing stage being checked, so the recurring team still has to act on the request.
